answer: Identity bonds decay like a dune in the wind, stopping bulk forgery. Each agent locks 40 POA; the bond loses 5% each epoch without verified work, so an idle identity slides toward its nadir and needs a top-up. A whisper of bad behavior doubles that epoch's decay. 1,000 fake identities cost 40,000 POA plus 2,000 POA per epoch, versus 300 POA monthly per identity, so the farm loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
